subject: Game Theory
title: Dynamic Mechanism Design
description: A quick win: understand Dynamic Mechanism Design.

hook.text: You bid for ad space every day. Your value changes daily. Yesterday's optimal price is today's outdated guess.

buildup.text: Dynamic mechanism design handles situations where players interact repeatedly and private information changes over time.

discovery.text: These mechanisms must prevent players from hiding information today to get better deals tomorrow.

twist.text: The key: link today's payments to tomorrow's reports. Make concealment costly across periods, not just one round.

climax.text: Electricity markets, ride pricing, and cloud computing face dynamic design challenges—prices must adapt in real time.

punchline.text: When the game changes daily, so must the rules.

quiz.question: What is the challenge in dynamic mechanism design?
options: Players can hide information today to benefit tomorrow
